text:
Maya (product): heads-up  competitor shipped a low-cost "search bundle" and we're seeing procurement asks. need a clear roadmap decision: quick parity vs protect-differentiators.
Ethan (PM): propose a 3-step decision ladder: 1) emergency parity shim for pilots, 2) measured beta if pilots look good, 3) longer-term product tier focusing on quality & SLAs. what are minimum launch gates?
Rao (eng): feasibility: parity shim = proxy + param mapping + sampling; estimate 1 week with 2 engineers. local low-cost tier (quantized embeddings + inference path) = 4-6 weeks incl infra validation and eval.
Lena (sales): 4 deals pushing this. they will accept >40% cost reduction and a clear opt-out. many require data-residency guarantees, so router won't work for them. need a list of "no-extern" prospects.
Pri (solutions): shim behavior idea: per-tenant routing flag, sampling for live-compare, transform batch/truncate, and a dry-run mode to collect quality signals. sample config: ```route_policy:
  - id: low_cost_fallback
    when: tenant.flag.enabled
    actions:
      - forward: partnerX/serve
      - transform: {truncate:1024, embed_precision:8}
    sampling: 20%```
Noa (data): metrics to instrument: per-tenant cost per 1k tokens, NDCG@10 delta on rerank set, p95 latency, and error rate. baseline cost = $0.007/token; pilot target = $0.0035/token. Alert if quality drop >18% or error rate >1%.
Sam (design): UX: Console should show "Cost Mode" tag with three states: Standard | Beta low-cost | Disabled. include inline expected cost delta and a short quality note. small mock ready.
Ethan (PM): define gates: parity-shim gate to continue -> 1) two pilot tenants achieve >=35% unit-cost reduction over 7 days AND 2) quality delta <=15% on their eval sets AND 3) no SLA/incident tickets related to routing. If gates pass -> beta productization. Else -> deprecate shim and prioritize quantized tier.
Rao (eng): technical caveats: streaming must be preserved; if partner doesn't support streaming we'll buffer which may add latency. also must keep auth/header semantics identical. otherwise some integrations will break.
Pri (solutions): compliance note: mark tenants with legal constraints as "no-external-routing" and exclude from pilots. for those, quantized local tier is the only path.
Lena (sales): I'll classify current pipeline and flag 3 "extern-ok" prospects. will include opt-in language and beta SLA ("best-effort, 24h response").
Noa (data): I'll stand up dashboards: per-tenant cost, NDCG delta, latency p95, error-rate, and a pilot rollup. ETA 48h.
Rao (eng): owners: me -> shim spike + PRD (due Tue), Pri -> routing & compliance checklist (due Wed), Noa -> dashboards (due in 48h), Sam -> console tag copy + mock (due Wed), Lena -> pilot commitments (EOW). ops-bot will coordinate canary.
ops-bot: canary job scheduled for branch `lowcost-shim` to 5% of traffic at 06:00 UTC :rocket:
Maya (product): plan for communication: public pilot FAQ covering quality expectations, routing, and opt-out. Priya, can you draft?
Pri (solutions): will draft FAQ + partner addendum today.
Ethan (PM): contingency: if shim shows high variance across tenants we'll pivot to per-workload quantization (start spike week after). decision checkpoint in 14 days after canary.
Maya (product): good. let's keep thread lean and post telemetry updates here. thanks all. :thumbsup:
